title: What the histogram shows

choices: An estimate of how the sample median varies from sample to sample
The 10,000 salaries closest to the median
The exact population distribution of salaries
explanations: Correct: the bootstrap distribution of the median.
Each value is a median of a whole resample.
That would be a histogram of the salaries themselves.
The bootstrap only sees the sample.

hints: It approximates the sampling distribution of the median.
solution: Each entry is a resample's median, so the histogram is the bootstrap distribution: an estimate of the sampling distribution of the median.
